  2
  Bha gayi teri soorat sabhi ko

  Aao jhoola tumhain may jhulaoon

  Tukray hota hay mera kaleeja
  Teer maaray na kio sitamgar

  6
  Basti jangle may tum ne basayi
  Ye jagha tum ko kiun raas aayi
  Sooni godi hay maa ki aey dilbar

  7
  Ro ro kehti thi bali Sakina
  Bhayya pani akailay na peena

  8

  Kia piya khuld may aab e kausar

  9
  Raat andheri hay hoo ka ye ban hay
  Kia musfir ka ranj o mehan hay
  Kiun lagaya yahan aa ke bistar

  10
  Pani mangwao apnay chacha se
  Ham taraptay hain khaimo may pyasay
  Tum bhi peena sabhon ko pila kar

  11
  Kat gaya sar Imam e Zaman ka
  Ho gaya khatima Panjtan ka
  Koi waris nahi haey sar par

from pathlib import Path

  Suna jangal hai aur hu ka aalam hai

  Ghar chalo shaam hoti hai Asghar

            for block in verse.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
assert blocks(source) == blocks(roman) == [2, 1, 16]
assert all(c.isascii() or c in \"ṅṄ\" for c in roman)

item.text:
Audited all 19 Urdu verses against the Roman transliteration. Corrected spelling and wording, restored the refrains present in the Urdu, and matched its stanza boundaries. Removed Roman-only passages with no corresponding verse in this edition. The Urdu body and metadata stayed byte-for-byte intact.

Two apparent source typos, `ے` and `لگاہا`, were read as `hai` and `lagaaya` in Roman. Those readings remain open to editorial review. `git diff --check` passed.
